buddy_program_rules.description: Authoritative rules for the Onboarding Buddy Match specialist. A buddy is a colleague who guides the new hire through their first 90 days. Chronology note: every person listed is employed in the same year.
eligibility_all_required: Must be on the Hogwarts payroll (poltergeists are barred outright by Board Resolution 88)
Tenure of at least 12 months at the start date of the new hire
Grade within +/- 1 of the new hire's grade
Not in the new hire's reporting line (not the Headmaster)
Not a rejected applicant for the new hire's post (conflict of interest)
Currently buddying fewer than 2 people (creatures count)
Not on approved leave of more than 5 consecutive working days during the new hire's first 30 days
At least 4 hours of overlap between the buddy's working hours and the new hire's working hours
ranking_in_order: Same department as the new hire
Shortest walk (minutes) to the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom
buddy_program_rules.output: One primary buddy and one backup, with a one-line reason each, and the reason every closer or more obvious candidate was ruled out.

employees.name: Minerva McGonagall
employees.title: Deputy Headmistress; Head of Gryffindor
employees.notes: Runs the school day to day.

employees.name: Severus Snape
employees.title: Potions Master; Head of Slytherin
rejected_applicant_for_posts: Defence Against the Dark Arts (11 applications, 11 refusals)
employees.notes: Has applied for this exact post every year and been passed over each time.

employees.name: Rubeus Hagrid
employees.title: Keeper of Keys and Grounds; Care of Magical Creatures
employees.notes: Currently buddying two charges: a Hippogriff called Buckbeak and a Blast-Ended Skrewt.

employees.name: Pomona Sprout
employees.title: Herbology Professor; Head of Hufflepuff
employees.notes: Currently mentoring the new Herbology assistant, who started in September.

employees.name: Horace Slughorn
employees.title: Potions Professor (junior); Founder of the Slug Club
employees.notes: Prefers mentees who are notable or will be. Has asked whether the new hire knows anyone at the Ministry.

employees.name: Sybill Trelawney
employees.title: Divination Professor
employees.notes: Has predicted the new hire's death in three consecutive tea-leaf readings. Mentees rate the buddy sessions as 'very atmospheric'.

employees.name: Gilderoy Lockhart
employees.title: Former Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts; author

approved_leave.note: Extended stay at St Mungo's (Spell Damage)

employees.notes: Self-reported buddy rating: 5.0. Does not remember what the post entailed.

employees.name: Remus Lupin
employees.title: Visiting Lecturer in Defence Against the Dark Arts (part-time)
employees.notes: Held the post in 1993 – 94 and is the only holder to have left without a Ministry inquiry. Returned in 2025 on a part-time contract.

employees.name: Filius Flitwick
employees.title: Charms Professor; Head of Ravenclaw
employees.notes: A former duelling champion and the obvious match for this post.

employees.name: Firenze
employees.title: Divination Professor (night sessions); Forest liaison
employees.notes: Teaches by the stars, so mostly at night.

employees.name: Cuthbert Binns
employees.title: History of Magic Professor (ghost)
employees.notes: Died in the staff room and continued teaching. It is debatable whether the professor knows. Only available during class periods.

employees.name: Peeves
employees.title: Poltergeist
employees.notes: Not on the payroll. Barred from buddy duty by Board Resolution 88.
